description: This file contains definitions of functions and context managers related to semi-structured sparse tensor operations in PyTorch, including handling sparse tensor views, matrix multiplication, addmm, linear transformations, and scaling for specialized sparse tensor types.

classes.name: torch.sparse.SparseSemiStructuredTensor
classes.description: Represents a semi-structured sparse tensor with methods for shape transformation and internal state management.

methods.name: __class__
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the tensor with transposed shape and related internal attributes.

classes.name: torch.sparse.SparseSemiStructuredTensorCUSPARSELT
classes.description: A specialized sparse tensor class optimized for cuSPARSELt operations, supporting scaled matrix multiplication.

methods.name: no_dispatch()
methods.description: Context manager that temporarily disables torch dispatch for safe execution of fallback functions.

methods.name: fallback_dispatcher(func, types, args, kwargs)
methods.description: Executes a function with dispatch disabled, useful for fallback implementations.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_values(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Returns the values tensor of a semi-structured sparse tensor, possibly slicing it.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_indices(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Returns the indices metadata of a semi-structured sparse tensor.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_t(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Returns a transposed view of a 2D semi-structured sparse tensor.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_view(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Returns a view of the sparse tensor with a specified shape, if supported.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_detach(func, types, args, kwargs)
methods.description: Returns a detached copy of the sparse tensor, resetting gradients.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_mm(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication between semi-structured sparse tensors and dense tensors.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_addmm(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Performs a scaled matrix multiplication with an added bias, for semi-structured sparse tensors.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_linear(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Performs a linear transformation on a semi-structured sparse tensor with optional bias.

methods.name: torch.Tensor semi_sparse_scaled_mm(func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Performs a scaled matrix multiplication for sparse tensors using cuSPARSELt, with per-tensor scaling factors.
